Don't worry, Supreme Leader, we'll take care of him.|Asajj Ventress speaking to this droid|}} A '''B1 battle droid''' served in the [[Separatist Droid Army|droid army]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. He was stationed on [[Rugosa]] during a [[Battle of Rugosa|battle]] in [[22 BBY]]. {{Droid-stub}} ==Biography== This [[droid]] was among the ground forces sent out to find [[Jedi Master]] [[Yoda]]. It was briefed prior by [[Sith apprentice]] [[Asajj Ventress]]. After asking what the [[Jedi]] looks like, it told Ventress the droids would take care of him. However, during their encounter with Yoda and the three [[clone trooper]]s that accompanied it, this droid was destroyed along with its companions. ==Characteristics== Like all [[B1-series battle droid|B1 battle droids]], it stood at 1.93 [[meter]]s tall. It sported [[bone]]-[[Color|white]] colored plating and was equipped with an [[E-5 blaster rifle]]. ==Behind the scenes== Its first and only appearance was in "[[Ambush]]," the first episode of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''' [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]], which originally aired on [[October 3]], [[2008]]. It was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]].{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode001.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Ambush}} ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Ambush}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:B1-series battle droids]] [[Category:Droids of the Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Category:Droids with unspecified gender programming]] [[Category:Droids with unspecified pronouns]]
